name: rails-app
title: Ruby on Rails app
blurb: Rails 8 JSON app: a service object for the logic, an integration test for the route, SQLite, CI

verify.name: counts
verify.cmd: bin/rails runner 'exit(TextStat.count("alpha beta\ngamma\n") == { lines: 2, words: 3, bytes: 17 } ? 0 : 1)'

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd: printf 'alpha beta\ngamma\n' > tmp/parity.txt && ours=$(bin/rails runner 'print TextStat.count(File.read("tmp/parity.txt")).values_at(:lines, :words, :bytes).join(" ")') && theirs=$(wc -l -w -c < tmp/parity.txt | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}') && echo "ours=$ours wc=$theirs" && test "$ours" = "$theirs"

verify.name: endpoint
verify.cmd: set +e; PORT=18082 bin/rails server > log/verify-server.log 2>&1 & server=$!; ready=1; for _ in $(seq 1 60); do if curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:18082/up; then ready=0; break; fi; sleep 1; done; body=$(curl -sS 'http://127.0.0.1:18082/stats?text=alpha+beta%0Agamma%0A'); status=$?; code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'http://127.0.0.1:18082/stats'); kill "$server" 2>/dev/null; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null; echo "ready=$ready body=$body code=$code"; test "$ready" -eq 0; test "$status" -eq 0; test "$body" = '{"lines":2,"words":3,"bytes":17}'; test "$code" = 400
